task: fix the TUI boot error «mpd-agent-team … Error: dsh-tui: root.effect is unavailable from a plugin activation» reported after installing the bundle into a dsh-tui profile
producedBy: captain session (single writer; no team staged)

revision.agentTeamLoadedByTheTuiProfile: 0.2.0-rc.1 (the harness copy; this bundle pins 0.1.7-rc.2 — both make the same ctx.root call)

symptom: mpd-agent-team (@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team): Error: dsh-tui: root.effect is unavailable from a plugin activation
defect.mechanism: TeamService's constructor registers its session projection through ctx.root.sessionProjections.register(...); Cordis binds a service call to the CALLER context, so the effect lands on the ROOT fiber, and the dsh-tui admission layer refuses root.effect from a plugin activation by design (host-access.d.ts). Config has no projection toggle and the call throws before any dedup, so no row value, mount order or isolate realm can change it.
sourceSites: @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui lib/types/dsh-adapter/activity-store.js (the host's own sanctioned pattern: ctx.inject + effect on the INJECTED fiber)
defect.notFixableByVersionPin: both the pinned 0.1.7-rc.2 copy and the harness 0.2.0-rc.1 copy call ctx.root.sessionProjections.register

fix.kind: !!js row-metadata guard on the row metadata key disabled (same shape as the existing mpd-better-sidebar mount guard)
fix.predicate: an entry whose options.name is @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui (or a subpath of it) or whose options.id starts with dsh-tui
fix.failMode: OPEN — a throwing guard keeps the row ENABLED and warns once, because a false disable would silently remove the team plane from a working Web/headless profile

the mpd team WORKFLOW rows (mpd-team-tools/compact/watchdog, mpd-roster-provider): their file-backed actions keep working and only service-dependent actions degrade through the adapter
